headline: Mortgage market returns to its dark history: Rates have risen for half a year in a row, and a turnaround is nowhere in sight
summary: Mortgage rates have risen for six months and reached their highest level in over two years. Banks are not yet planning broad reductions, and experts expect further increases or stagnation.
why: Mortgage rates shape household borrowing costs and housing demand, and they reflect broader financing conditions in the banking sector.
